items.title: What Is AbbVie No Longer Telling You?
items.summary: AbbVie's management has changed what it puts first on its earnings calls. One growth figure used to open the script. Management last mentioned that figure in the fiscal fourth quarter 2025 call. AbbVie (ABBV) never said it would stop reporting it. So which figure was it, and why did it matter.

items.title: What Is The Best Case For Pfizer Stock?
items.summary: Pfizer's COVID products keep shrinking. The company's total revenue has been flat for a year. That makes the best case for this stock easy to miss. It does not rest on the medicines you already know Pfizer (PFE) for. It is not another round of cost cuts either. It rests on a smaller and faster part of the company. So where is that growth coming from.

items.title: How to Maximize Your Retirement Portfolio with These Top-Ranked Dividend Stocks
items.summary: The traditional retirement planning approaches no longer cover all expenses in nest egg years. So what can retirees do? Thankfully, there are alternative investments that provide steady, higher-rate income streams to replace dwindling bond yields.

items.title: 4 Elite Dividend Stocks Yielding Up to 6.14% With Diversified Pipelines That Protect Your Payout
items.summary: Patent cliffs have buried lesser pharma dividends, yet these four Big Pharma giants keep raising payouts despite losing blockbuster exclusivities worth billions. Find out which one has held its streak for 64 straight years and whether the 6% yielder is a trap or a genuine opportunity.

items.title: Eli Lilly Breaks Ground on $6.5B Generation Park Facility
items.summary: A $6.5B Eli Lilly biomanufacturing facility broke ground at Houston’s Generation Park, Texas’ largest pharmaceutical investment to date.

items.title: Could You Have Seen Merck Stock's Pipeline Run Coming?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock gained about 89% in the year from mid-September 2025, against a 17.1% price gain for the S&P 500. It also beat Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), up 58%, and Eli Lilly (LLY), up 54%. The signs were public long before the run, in what management kept saying about its drug pipeline. The reported sales told a different story.

items.title: BMY vs GILD: Which Biotech Stock Looks More Attractive Now?
items.summary: Bristol Myers' growth portfolio and pipeline advances offer multiple ways to offset legacy-product erosion, while valuation and leverage remain key factors.

items.title: What Would It Take For Pfizer To Cut Its Dividend?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) has returned 23.1% over the past year and trades about 5% below its three-year high. Yet one question keeps coming back on its earnings calls: would it ever cut the dividend? An analyst asked it outright on the August call, and another tied it to a big acquisition in May. So what would a cut take, and what would it change.
